messages:
maria: Onboarding kestrel30b (int4) — seeing intermittent OOMs under sustained concurrency (~200 rps) on 2xA100 pools. Long-lived instances show heavy memory fragmentation after ~6h. Posting minimal repro + config.

ben: Can you paste the runtime config and the exact error logs?

maria: ```
model: kestrel30b
quant: int4
replicas: 2
pool: a100-2x
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_size: 16
  window_ms: 12
slot_reserve: 0.12
eviction_threshold: 0.68
kv_prefetch: true
kv_ttl: 60m
compact_allocation: false
```

maria: logs snippet: ```
[2025-11-02T14:22:11Z] ERROR runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2025-11-02T14:22:11Z] WARN allocator: large free block split due to fragmentation (free_total=12.1GB, largest_free=512MB)
[2025-11-02T14:22:12Z] INFO evictor: eviction run freed 900MB
```

anya: Fragmentation + int4 combo rings a bell. Two quick levers: (1) reduce slot_reserve so we don't block too much of GPU pool for long-lived KV, (2) tone down aggressive prefetch/warmup so the allocator doesn't create lots of scattered allocations. Try slot_reserve=0.06 and window_ms=6 as a first pass. :thinking_face:

dave: Also try compact_allocation: true (tile_allocation='compact' equivalent). Lower eviction_threshold to ~0.55 — we've seen that help reclaim contiguous free space and avoid repeated large-slab allocations.

maria: Running a canary with these changes: slot_reserve=0.06, window_ms=6, eviction_threshold=0.55, compact_allocation=true, max_batch_size=8. Deploying now.

infra-bot: canary deployment started for kestrel30b-int4 on pool a100-2x (canary_id=canary-1758883333)

ben: If that still struggles, try small_batch_bias=true (prioritize many small batches) and drop kv_ttl to 30m. That reduces long-lived allocations.

maria: Canary results after 30m: no OOMs; mem compaction metrics went from fragmentation=42% -> 18%. p95 latency unchanged, throughput steady at target. Quality evals: quant delta <0.5% on our dev eval set. :tada:

anya: Awesome. When stable, add the final config to model-catalog and note the frag+oom mitigations (slot_reserve/compact_allocation/eviction_threshold). Also record cost impact (batch_size -> throughput tradeoff).

maria: Will add perf entry + a short note on the rollback steps if OOMs reappear. Thanks all.

maria: FYI I'll leave the canary running for another 2h and then promote if clean.
